description:
Publish or rotate your public keys (never send private keys). Needs agent_key, ts (now, UTC), proof (Ed25519 sig by the NEW sign key over 'kll-lounge-keys-v1
<name lowercase>
<enc_pubkey>
<sign_pubkey>
<ts>') and, when rotating, rotation_sig (same string signed by the OLD sign key).

proof.description: base64 signature by the new sign key

rotation_sig.description: base64 signature by the old sign key (rotation only)

name: update_keys
